{{Quote|They are ''very'' dignified, ''very'' sensible beings, and they expect to be treated with respect. Is that clear?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], describing the Drall to his children|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
The '''Drall''' were a small, furry, and highly intelligent species found on [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. They were descended from burrowing mammals and they were extremely diligent record-keepers, and it was said that they had recorded every trivial event since the dawn of intelligence. Libraries were among their greatest forms of entertainment, as were story-telling sessions called [[Ta'sharr]].

The planet from which they originated was unknown; thousands of years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] transported the species to Drall in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Drall was usually hot and members of the species were covered with thick fur. Drall rarely wore any clothes except a belt to carry personal belongings. They were very fond of jewelry composed of ores and gems, which they made into beautiful works of art. Some Drall also believe that they originally hibernated before becoming civilized and build rooms in their houses that remind them of caves. These rooms help the Drall relax and think clearly.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|An adult Drall is about as tall as you are, Jacen, but a lot heavier set. They have two short legs and two short arms in the usual places. They have short brown or black or gray fur-or sometimes red. Their bodies look a little like taller, thinner Ewoks with shorter fur, but their heads are completely different. Rounder, more, ah, intelligent looking to human eyes, with a bit more pronounced muzzle, and with their ears flat to the head instead of sticking up.|Han Solo|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Drall-AE.png|thumb|right|120px|A Drall child]]
Their notable traits were being small bipeds with furry features<ref name="TEGtAS" /> who were stated to be descended from burrowing animals.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> Their faces held a pair of black eyes.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> They had short muzzles and almond shaped<ref name="UAA" /> black eyes.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> Their bodies were covered with fur which ranged from brown and black to reddish-gray. Drall had short limbs with clawed hands and feet. Adult members of the species stood between 0.9 to 1.5 meters tall with females being taller as well as more solidly built when compared to males.<ref name="UAA" /> They had a life span of around 250 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] and reached maturity at the age of 15.<ref name="AE" />

==History==
They were noted for being natives of the Corellian system<ref name="TEGtAS" /> and claimed their descent from burrowing animals.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />
Around 35,000 years prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a Drall scientist by the name of [[Tiran]] created the [[Theory of Universal Reference]] and postulated that the speed-of-light was a boundary that was incapable of being crossed. This was 10,000 years prior to the discovery of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] technology.<ref name="MS1">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

During the [[Corellian Crisis]], [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Marcha]] and [[Ebrihim]] worked with [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and put their Drallish minds to uncovering a subterranean [[planetary repulsor]] that was used in ancient times to move their world to its current orbit. The Drall [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] was used to later disable [[Centerpoint Station]] when it was being used against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" />

==Culture==
{{Quote|Furry aliens; mostly live in the Corellian system. Disgusting little rodents.|Lieutenant [[Veet]]|<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
They were known for a gentle contenance and being a highly dignified species<ref name="TEGtAS" /> despite their small stature.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> Drall were known for being a very practical and orderly people.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> The Drall were a methodical and levelheaded race that made most excellent scholars as well as scientists.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> By nature, they were abstract thinkers that preferred to develop new scientific theories rather than put them into practice. Thus, despite their advanced scholarly pursuits, they often trail behind the rest of the galaxy in terms of technological achievements.<ref name="AE" /> Instead, they usually simply implement technologies that had been developed elsewhere. Most Drall tend to hold positions in processing medicinal agriculture which was their homeworld's primary industry. The species was rarely encountered elsewhere in the galaxy though offworld corporations tended to hire Drall as scientific researchers.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> Their meticulous note and record keeping was known to record every trivial event since the dawn of their intelligence to the point that they say it was claimed that there was no prehistory on their homeworld.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />

[[File:Gambling-EotESoF.png|thumb|right|250px|A Drall gambling]]
In terms of society, they were notable for being clan-based and hierarchical with no elected head of state. Instead, powerful family groups were responsible for running the government. Within each family, the head was generally the eldest female who held the title of Duchess. Upon the death of this title holder, all her holdings and even her title passed to the female of the next generation that had demonstrated both levelheadedness along with leadership skills necessary for their new role.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> The Duchess worked with all family matters and held a daily [[Ta'sharr]] with the children of the clan. Drall family members supported tourism in areas like the [[Boiling Sea]], they also worked as scholars and trinketsmiths. When a member of a Drall clan reached 18, the members of the clan gathered together and the Duchess awarded the [[Scepter of Drall]] to the person.

Drall rarely carried weapons and were usually peaceful and quiet. Drall police officers wore medallions around their necks and carried [[Flashstick/Legends|flashsticks]] to disable criminals. The [[Wingriders]] were a division of police that rode [[ibbot]] mounts.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Other notable groups amongst their society included the [[Drallist Front|Drallists]] and [[Drallish Front]] who wanted to rid their homeworld of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]].<ref name="AaS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>

As a people, the Drall's love for gossip has become something of a cultural tradition among their race.<ref name="TEGtAS" /> They were noted for being cautious creatures that seldom ventured from their home system. Despite this being the case, they were known to be seen on other worlds<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> and corporations were known to hire them for their skills.<ref name="TEGtAS" />

*Garth
*Gredda
*Hedreg
*Norghar

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: The Corellian Trilogy]]'' referred to the Drall species as ''Drallan''. In most other sources they are simply called ''Drall''.

Although previous sources might state that the Drall are native to the planet Drall, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' indicates that they were actually transported to the planet by the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] thousands of years earlier.
